title: ThermalModel
description: A thermal RC network: room nodes, boundary nodes, resistive edges, and heat sources. Assembles to a linear ODE C·dT/dt = -L·T + B·u(t).

schema_version.description: Schema version — bump when making breaking changes.

nodes.description: Room air nodes — each has a thermal capacitance and an initial temperature.

id.description: Node identifier, referenced by edges and sources.

C.description: Thermal capacitance [J/K]. Either a fixed value or derived from an assembly.

oneOf.description: Derived from an assembly and area.

kind.description: air = zone air node; mass = internal thermal mass (wall core, slab, furniture).

T_initial.description: Initial temperature [°C]. Defaults to first value of T_series if omitted.

ui_position.description: Canvas position for the Svelteflow editor.

boundaries.description: Fixed-temperature boundary nodes (exterior, deep soil). Not solved — they are forcing inputs.

T_source.description: Temperature forcing: a timeseries signal name or a fixed value.

oneOf.description: Signal name from the simulation inputs (e.g. open_meteo/temperature_2m).

edges.description: Thermal resistances connecting two nodes (room↔room, room↔boundary).

R.description: Thermal resistance [K/W]. Either a fixed value or derived from a construction + area.

oneOf.description: Derived: R = (R_si + sum(e/λ) + R_se) / area. R_si and R_se come from the construction.

construction_id.description: References a construction by its id.

solar_surfaces.description: Oriented surfaces used to derive plane-of-array (POA) irradiance from weather inputs. Each surface produces a named signal (its id) that heat_sources can reference.

id.description: Signal name produced by this surface, referenced in heat_sources as signal. Convention: poa/<name>.

tilt.description: Surface tilt from horizontal [°]. 0 = horizontal (roof), 90 = vertical (wall).

azimuth.description: Surface azimuth [°], meteorological convention: 0/360 = North, 90 = East, 180 = South, 270 = West.

albedo.description: Ground albedo used for the reflected irradiance component. Default 0.2 (typical ground).

shading_factor.description: Scalar shading factor applied to beam irradiance [0–1]. 1.0 = unobstructed, 0.0 = fully shaded. MVP placeholder — will be replaced by a horizon profile in a future schema version.

heat_sources.description: Time-varying heat inputs into a node (solar gain, internal gains, HVAC).

node.description: Target node id that receives the heat input.

kind.description: solar: signal [W/m²] × gain [m²] (e.g. SHGC × window area); internal/hvac: signal [W] × gain [-] (dimensionless scale factor).

signal.description: Signal name from simulation inputs. Unit depends on kind: W/m² for solar, W for internal/hvac.

gain.description: Gain coefficient. For solar: effective aperture area [m²] (≈ SHGC × A_window). For internal/hvac: dimensionless scale factor. Heat input = gain × signal.
